sloka: सीताया रहितो अहम् वै न हि जीवामि लक्ष्मण ।वृतम् शोकेन महता सीता हरणजेन माम् ॥३-६१-६॥
transliteration: sītāyā rahito aham vai na hi jīvāmi lakṣmaṇa ।vṛtam śokena mahatā sītā haraṇajena mām ॥3-61-6॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, I cannot live without Sita. I am filled with deep grief on account of Sita's abduction. My late father, the king will certainly see me in the other world (I will definitely commit suicide).
